target.summary: Matching only the literal '^^5c' fails to recognize other valid TeX-encoded backslashes (such as '^^^^005c' or zero-padded variants), causing them to be improperly escaped in text mode and allowing unsafe commands using alternative encodings to bypass sanitize_mathmode.
notes: Added mapping only matches the literal '^^5c' instead of all TeX-encoded backslash variants in text mode
Regex only matches the literal '^^5c' instead of all TeX-encoded backslash variants in sanitize_mathmode
